title: Add public sitemap.xml and robots.txt for SEO — growth/acquisition
description: Generate a dynamic sitemap.xml at /sitemap.xml that includes all public routes: landing, about, pricing, categories, counties, directory, listings, and public member profiles. Add a robots.txt at /robots.txt that allows all crawlers and points to the sitemap. Use Next.js built-in sitemap.ts convention (app/sitemap.ts) and robots.ts (app/robots.ts). Include lastmod dates for dynamic content (listings, profiles) based on updated_at. Acceptance: sitemap renders valid XML with correct URLs, robots.txt allows all and references sitemap, and tests verify both endpoints return correct content types.
notes: Fixed robots.ts SITE_URL const to runtime read; tests pass. Commit: 9f34cab

title: Add in-app notifications dropdown to AppNav — retention/engagement
description: Create a notifications bell icon in AppNav that shows a dropdown of recent in-app notifications (unread messages, listing saves, trade completions, reviews, referrals). Add a notifications table (profile_id, type, title, body, link_url, is_read, created_at) with RLS. Add a server action to mark notifications as read. Display unread count badge on the bell. Track notification_bell_clicked, notification_marked_read in PostHog. Acceptance: bell shows in AppNav, dropdown renders notifications, unread badge updates, mark-as-read works, and tests cover rendering + action.
notes: Feature already implemented in prior run. Fixed failing tests by adding in_app_notifications mock to notifications-data.test.ts and notifications-trade-prompts.test.ts. All 783 tests pass. Commit: TBD

title: Add Gift Premium CTA to dashboard quick-actions grid — revenue/monetization
description: Add a 'Gift Premium' card to the dashboard quick-actions grid that links to /dashboard/billing#gift. Use a Gift icon, show 'Buy Premium for a friend' copy, and track gift_premium_dashboard_cta_clicked in PostHog. Only show for authenticated users (all tiers). Acceptance: card renders in quick-actions grid, links to billing page with hash anchor, analytics fires, and tests cover visibility + link correctness.
